layer.$description: Stacking order (z-index) of app layers, lowest to highest. Never use other numbers; a new layer is added here.

raised.$description: 1 · Element lifted above its siblings in the same area — badge on an avatar, selected tab indicator, sticky table column inside its table.

sticky.$description: 1100 · App bar, sticky headers and toolbars that stay on top while content scrolls under them.

drawer.$description: 1200 · Side navigation drawer and side/bottom sheets.

modal.$description: 1400 · Dialogs and full-screen modals, above their scrim.

toast.$description: 1500 · Snackbars and toasts — above modals so feedback is always visible.

tooltip.$description: 1600 · Tooltips and popovers anchored to an element — always on top.
